positions.name: ReviewerEnrollmentProbe
positions.frame: what does this probe memory establish about automatic reviewer enrollment on save?
positions.why: src-1 states the e2e-suite assertion being tested (saving a memory enrolls its creator as reviewer), and src-2 frames this very memory's existence as purpose-built to carry that assertion — read together they cohere as a single evidentiary unit for the enrollment claim, not two independent statements.
